Work Schedule 
 
 Environmental Conditions 
 
 Job Description 
 
 Summarized Purpose: 
 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build production-ready web applications with React/Next.js, Node.js, JavaScript, AWS, AI-assisted development, and SQL/Oracle databases.
 Education/Experience: 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
 Minimum 5 years of experience in full stack application development with exposure to AI/LLM-enabled application features
 Major Job Responsibilities: 
 Develop responsive user interfaces using React/Next.js and CSS frameworks such as MUI or Bootstrap
 Build backend services and APIs using Node.js and JavaScript, with clean integration to frontend applications
 Design, develop, and consume APIs that support polished user experiences and business workflows
 Use AI assistants and agentic tools such as Codex or ChatGPT to accelerate development, debugging, and code review
 Work with SQL databases such as MySQL and Oracle, including querying, data validation, and basic schema understanding
 Design, deploy, and support AWS infrastructure using EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, Auto Scaling Groups, and Security Groups, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable application environments.
 Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teams using GitHub workflows, Agile practices, and release discipline
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
 Strong hands-on experience with React/Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern component-based frontend development
 Experience with Node.js backend development, REST APIs, service integration, and production support
 Working knowledge of AI-assisted development tools such as Codex or ChatGPT for coding, debugging, and task acceleration
 Experience querying and working with relational databases, including MySQL and Oracle
 Familiarity with AWS services and cloud deployment concepts is preferred
 Strong problem-solving, collaboration, debugging, and communication skills
 Must Have Skills: 
 React/Next.js and JavaScript frontend development
 Node.js backend application development
 API development and consumption across frontend and backend systems
 SQL database experience, preferably with MySQL and Oracle
 Good to Have Skills: 
 AWS infrastructure or deployment experience
 Exposure to Java/Spring, with ability to learn on the job
 Experience with MUI, Bootstrap, or similar UI frameworks
 Working Hours: 
 India: 01:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST
 Philippines: 03:30 PM to 12:30 AM PHT
